name: Anand Rathi Wealth Ltd
title: Anand Rathi Wealth Ltd - 543415 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Wealth manager posts FY26 PAT of INR 386 crores (+28%) on AUM crossing INR 1 lakh crore; FY27 PAT guide of INR 460 crores implies about 19% growth, below the stated 20-25% range.

triggers.label: FY27 PAT guide INR 460 crores
triggers.quote: PAT guidance of INR 460 crores, again, going with the principles

triggers.label: Net flows up only 7% to INR 13,457 crores
triggers.quote: INR 13,457 crores is what we collected new

triggers.label: Trail yield squeeze 2-5 bps, seen as minor
triggers.quote: if there is a squeeze, it can be of 2,4 , 5 BPS

guidance.metric: FY27 revenue (ex FV gains and ESOP)
guidance.quote: We have given FY '27 revenue guidance of INR 1,415 crores and PAT guidance of INR 460 crores

guidance.metric: FY27 PAT (before ESOP and FV adjustments)
guidance.quote: INR 460 crores is our PAT guidance before any of those adjustments
INR 1,20,000 crores of AUM for the year ending FY '27 is our guidance

prior_guidance_check.quote: ending at INR 386 crores against the INR 375 crores guided
we have crossed INR1 lakh crores of AUM

red_flags.label: ESOP at face value; Rs 39.3 cr hit in Q4 treated as non-recurring
red_flags.quote: ESOPs are going to be issued at the face value, okay?

red_flags.label: Mark-to-market gain of Rs 54.6 cr on unlisted group NBFC stake
red_flags.quote: the value has gone up by INR 54.6 crores, and that is the amount which has been booked under fair value change

evasions.quote: I don't know about the projection. But yes, we can give you that specific projection one on one.
I don't have the P&L of Anand Rathi Global Finance handy right now.
I will not throw a number because they're not published.
